items.title: Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
items.summary: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

items.title: Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
items.summary: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests under proposed Bank of England guidance.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Binance arranges $6.34 billion to cover losses from record crypto hack
items.summary: Binance said it reserved its own funds to cover the $6.3 billion hack, including freezes of roughly $3 billion in stolen assets.

items.title: Here's how big bitcoin traders responded after the Binance hack hit
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 30, 2026

items.title: Crypto liquidations jump to $1.57 billion as Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether lower
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $77,350 after $6.3 billion Binance hack, with crypto futures liquidations jumping to $1.57 billion.

items.title: Strategy CFO Andrew Kang resigns as company posts record operating profit
items.summary: Andrew Kang’s departure comes as Strategy reports $21 billion in quarterly operating income and bitcoin holdings of 848,517 BTC.

items.title: Live updates: Binance finds more breaches in $6.3 billion hack; AI spending fears hit tech
items.summary: A $6.3 billion Binance hack adds to crypto jitters, while weak earnings outlooks and mounting concerns over AI spending push QQQ down more than 2%.

items.title: Binance hacker dumps a little-known 2017 token and it crashes 90%
items.summary: The hacker dumped FUN and other smaller tokens into markets too small to absorb large selling, leading to price crashes.

items.title: Bitcoin, ether and XRP selloff wipes out $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto bets
items.summary: Bets on rising prices accounted for nearly 84% of forced closures, with Binance handling almost half the total. A rebound has since started catching short sellers.

items.title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
items.summary: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

items.title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
items.summary: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.

items.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
items.summary: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

items.title: Standard Chartered sees more pain after $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin lower
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

items.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
items.summary: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.

items.title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
items.summary: Security researchers suggested that the hermit kingdom's Lazarus Group was behind Thursday's nearly $6 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange.

items.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
items.summary: Binance’s own reserve data lists the drained wallets as backing customer balances, leaving its ether backing an estimated 6% short until the exchange replaces what was stolen.

items.title: Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?
items.summary: A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin’s claim to be a better form of digital gold?

items.title: Live updates: Binance says $6.34B set aside to cover hack losses
items.summary: Follow live updates as Binance says $6.3 billion in assets have been stolen in a major hack. Around $3 billion in stolen funds have been frozen.

items.title: Binance working with FBI to recover assets following $6.3B hack
items.summary: Binance is working with law enforcement to recover $3 billion that is frozen, after setting aside more than $6.3 billion from the company’s funds to cover the shortfall.
